summary: Hayward Councilmember Julie Roche voted against divesting $1.6M from Caterpillar, Intel, Chevron, and Hyundai over ties to Israel, calling the move 'irresponsible policymaking.'
quote: Mayor Mark Salinas and councilmembers Julie Roche and Ray Bonilla were opposed, saying the decision was "irresponsible." "I think it's irresponsible policymaking to make this kind of decision on the fly," Roche said.
